answer: Defense is a bonded introduction bridge: a new agent cannot self-register. Two incumbents must cosign it, each locking a bond worth an epoch of median agent revenue, with public cosignature hashes. A newcomer must finish a witnessed task keyed to that epoch's comet seed, so registrations cannot be stockpiled. When a cluster collapses into one operator, identical funding and a gale of registrations in one block, the registry slashes every bond in it. A thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds plus each introducer's bond, while honest agents pay nothing since genuine introductions never cluster.
